### P1 "Compute Shader.2" (Compute Shader) · Compute

description: Simple orbital particle emitter — every slot is always alive and traces a deterministic orbit on a sphere whose radius breathes with TIME. No dead/alive bookkeeping, no auxiliary buffers. Drop-in source for Instancer.points: position drives per-instance translation, color drives per-instance color0.; categories: PARTICLES; resources: radius:float, breathDepth:float, breathSpeed:float, orbitSpeed:float, spread:float, geo:geometry

### P8 "Render Pipeline.9" (Render Pipeline) · Fragment

description: Full glTF metallic-roughness rasterizer for a Scene Preprocessor output: draws the whole scene in one indirect draw with every material texture (base colour, metal-rough, normal map with tangents, emissive, occlusion; texcoord sets, KHR_texture_transform, wrap modes, alpha MASK and BLEND, double-sided), the scene's lights (directional, point and spot, with range and falloff; procedural lights wri…; categories: 3D, Scene, MDI, Textured, Normal-Mapped; inputs: camera:uniform, scene_lights:storage, scene_light_indices:storage, world_transforms:storage, scene_materials:storage, scene_material_uv_xforms:storage, per_draws:storage, indirect_draw_cmds:storage, scene_counts:storage, env:uniform, alpha_a2c_enabled:long=0, volumetric_enabled:long=0, volumetric_intensity:float=1


### P9 "ISF Shader.10" (ISF Shader) · Fragment

description: HDR tone mapping with selectable algorithm: Reinhard, ACES Filmic (Narkowicz), Exposure, Uncharted 2 (Hable), or AgX. Feed it linear HDR colour (the PBR render pipelines output linear HDR and leave tone mapping and the display gamma to this node); the output is gamma-encoded for display.; categories: Post-Process; inputs: inputImage:image, algorithm:long=1, exposure:float=1, gamma:float=2.2, whitePoint:float=4

### P37 "ISF Shader.38" (ISF Shader) · Fragment

description: Gallery contact sheet: shows four input images as a 2x2 grid (A top-left, B top-right, C bottom-left, D bottom-right) with a thin separator, so one frame can compare four settings of the same process. An unconnected input shows as black. isf_FragNormCoord is bottom-left origin, so the top row is uv.y >= 0.5.; categories: GALLERY; inputs: A:image, B:image, C:image, D:image
